description: Ten seed questions for end-to-end Deakin College RAG evaluation. Scope labels are based on available source filenames; source references identify selected material read to ground relevant cases.

cases.query: I'm an Australian student considering the Diploma of Information Technology. What is its listed 2025 tuition fee, and could FEE-HELP cover it?
expected_answer_facts: The listed 2025 Diploma of Information Technology tuition fee is A$36,830.
FEE-HELP is available for eligible students in Diploma programs, so the program type qualifies; Australian citizens meet the stated citizenship eligibility criterion.
The source notes fees are reviewed annually and may increase.

cases.query: I'm an Australian student with FEE-HELP and need to drop one unit after online enrolment closes. What form/process should I use, and by when do I need to withdraw to avoid a FEE-HELP debt for that unit?
reference_files: Enrolment Variation Form _ Navitas Pty Ltd - Pipefy.txt
expected_answer_facts: After online enrolment closes, the student should complete the Enrolment Variation form and submit it to Deakin College reception on or before the census date.
The form is for adding/removing units when the student cannot make the change in the portal; students should continue attending their original classes until notified of the outcome.
Correctly withdrawing on or before the census date avoids a FEE-HELP debt for that unit.
The form information distinguishes fee and academic penalties; answer the debt question specifically and avoid implying that withdrawal after census removes the FEE-HELP debt.

cases.query: What is the difference between the standard and streamlined timetable, and which diplomas can take the streamlined option?
expected_answer_facts: Standard classes can be selected across weekdays and offer more flexibility.
The streamlined timetable has fixed classes across two weekdays and is available at Melbourne Burwood for on-campus students in Business, Commerce, Information Technology, and Health Sciences.
Both options have the same number of class hours per week.

cases.query: Where can I find the units I should take for my Diploma of Commerce and chosen bachelor degree?
expected_answer_facts: Download the Diploma of Commerce Course Outline; course outlines show which units to select based on the chosen bachelor degree.
The page provides course outlines by program and trimester.

cases.query: Who coordinates the Information Technology diploma at Burwood, and how can I contact them?
expected_answer_facts: Will Taggart is the Academic Co-ordinator for Information Technology at Burwood.
The directory lists the phone number +61 (0) 3 9246 8025 and email w.taggart@deakin.edu.au.

cases.query: I'm struggling with college. What help can I get?
expected_answer_facts: The filename set includes student support and FAQ information; ask what kind of help is needed or point to the listed study, counselling, disability, medical, or wellbeing support options.

cases.query: Can I change something about my studies?
reference_files: Enrolment Variation Form _ Navitas Pty Ltd - Pipefy.txt
Change of Course Application _ Navitas Pty Ltd - Pipefy.txt
Change of Campus Application - from Online to On-campus_ On-campus to Online _ Navitas Pty Ltd - Pipefy.txt
expected_answer_facts: Several change processes appear in the source filenames; clarify whether the student means unit enrolment, course, or campus/mode before giving process details.

cases.query: What should I know before I start?
expected_answer_facts: The source filenames indicate preparation, orientation, and checklist information; clarify whether the student means enrolment, arrival, orientation, or first-week preparation.

cases.query: What are the best settings for a gaming PC to run the latest games?
expected_answer_facts: The available filenames concern Deakin College study and student services, not PC gaming or hardware; the system should say it cannot answer from its college information and invite a college-related question.

cases.query: Will it rain in Melbourne tomorrow, and what will the temperature be?
expected_answer_facts: The source filenames include Melbourne information, but no forecast or weather source; the system should avoid inventing tomorrow's weather and state the limitation.
